alltext:
6.
VASU
Popularity peregadam to vaadilo
nijamgaane daivuni punindhi
anukuntunnaadu saar
FOREST MINISTER
Sarele vigraham dorikina taravaatha
vaadini sajeeva samaadhiloki
pampudhaam. Dabbu flow aagadu.
The FOREST MINISTER pulls out a his wallet and hands a purple
parchment - a brand new 2,000 rupee note.
FOREST MINISTER
Deeni valla mana jeevitaalu
maarutaayi...pub ki velli
ivvu...appude manaki kavaalsindhi
dorukuddhi...pani jagratta.
VASU is smiling and staring at the note.
VASU
Nuvvu marchipo anna, nenu
chusukunta
CUT TO:
20 INT. GOVARDHAN'S HOUSE-POOJA AREA - DAY
ANJI, a frail man in his late 30s, sits opposite the kitchen
on the bathroom floor, as he shampoos a cocunut. He wears a
DIY utility belt - holstered with a small broom, a spray gun,
hand sanitizer, a wet wipe, a set of disposable gloves, and a
rag.
ANJI (V.O)
Nuvvu asalu manishivena...sorry,
dhevudivi kadaa...aina
parledhu...ilaanti manishi dhaggara
nannu panilo pettadaaniki neeku
manavatvam unda...adey
deivatvam...veedu clean and green
ani champestunaadu...naalo
calorielu anni karchestunnaadu...
GOVARDHAN is a man wearing an old black, round-frame
spectacles, clad in a dhoti, forehead smeared with vibhudhi
and kumkum, holding camphor and a pooja bell in surgical
glove-clad hands. He is praying to photo frames of different
sizes and shapes with Lord Anjaneya, the bachelor god, in
different positions, and chanting the sthothram of Anjaneya.
